heroTitle: Your civic complaint, in your social worker's hands within seconds.
heroDescription: Potholes, overflowing garbage, broken street lights or no water supply - register once, report in a minute, and let the portal deliver it straight to WhatsApp with photos and a map pin.
steps: Register once with your Pune address details
File a complaint with photos and a pinned location
Your social worker receives it on WhatsApp instantly
Follow the status until it is marked resolved

features.title: Resident Registration
features.body: Create a verified household profile with your address, ward and PIN code so every complaint is routed to the right area.

features.title: Grievance Management
features.body: Raise complaints with photos, exact map location and a contact number. Track the status from submitted to resolved.

features.title: Instant WhatsApp Alert
features.body: Every new complaint is pushed to the social worker's WhatsApp within seconds - no email, no waiting, no paperwork.

footer: Built for residents of Pune, Maharashtra.
